name: Anafenza
description: Anafenza is a character of Tarkir who is khan of the Abzan Houses in the original timeline and a Dromoka captain executed for necromancy in the alternate timeline.

description_citations.text: "The Guardian" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2015.

status.text: In the alternate timeline Anafenza is dead, executed by Oret, though a ghostly figure like her is said to fight alongside the Dromoka and the latest page says she died for bonding with a Kin-Tree.

citations.text: "The Guardian" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2015.

citations.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 2
citations.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 2". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Mar 2015.

timeline.summary: Anafenza holds court under the First Tree while the gates of Mer-Ek are sealed.
timeline.quote: When Anafenza holds court under the First Tree, the gates of Mer-Ek are sealed.

citation.text: Dazzling Ramparts (Khans of Tarkir, 2014), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Defectors like Anafenza challenge Dromoka and are killed, but the rebellion gains steam during the New Phyrexian Invasion.
timeline.quote: who challenged the dragonlord and were ultimately killed for their disobedience.

citation.text: "Abzan Houses", section "Revival of the Abzan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Anafenza finds the remains of the nearly extinct Kin-Trees, which are revived with necromantic magic.
timeline.quote: In the years since, many of their remains were found by Anafenza .

citation.text: "Abzan Houses", section "Kin-Trees". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gvar tries to befriend young Anafenza but she refuses to acknowledge his kinship.
timeline.quote: Gvar attempted to be friends with Anafenza, calling her cousin

citation.text: "Gvar Barzeel", section "Original timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A Sultai raiding party topples the rolling fortress; Anafenza and Gvar survive and flee into the desert.
timeline.quote: A pair of the mastodons toppled the entire fortress

citation.text: "Gvar Barzeel", section "Original timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Anafenza and Gvar kill the pursuing Abzan traitors; one admits Oret hired the Sultai.
timeline.quote: it had been Anafenza's cousin Oret who had hired the Sultai and staged the attack

citation.text: "Gvar Barzeel", section "Original timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the ceremony for Khan Anafenza, Gvar forces Oret to his knees and she disowns him.
timeline.quote: Gvar stepped up and forced Oret to his knees.

citation.text: "Gvar Barzeel", section "Original timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the original timeline, Oret hires a Sultai assassin whose zombie mastodons topple the family's rolling fortress.
timeline.quote: Oret had hired Sultai assassin who used four zombie mastodons to topple the entire fortress

citation.text: "Oret", section "Original timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Years later Anafenza, now khan, disowns the traitor Oret in a blood rite.
timeline.quote: Performing a blood rite before the First Tree and the eyes of their ancestors, she disowned him.

citation.text: "Oret", section "Original timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Anafenza, newly khan for two weeks, climbs the First Tree barefoot and prepares to face the heads of the houses and one hated family member.
timeline.quote: Anafenza always climbed barefoot.

citation.text: "Bond and Blood" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Dec 2014.

timeline.summary: The heads of the clan houses gather to swear kinship, and Anafenza receives them at the Amber Throne.
timeline.quote: The houses had elected Anafenza to be khan

citation.text: "Bond and Blood" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Dec 2014.

timeline.summary: The last delegate, her cousin Oret, recognizes Anafenza and is seized with fear.
timeline.quote: Recognition. Then fear.

citation.text: "Bond and Blood" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Dec 2014.

timeline.summary: At her command, an orc forces Oret to his knees, and Anafenza draws the Khan-Blade.
timeline.quote: Anafenza ascended the dais to her throne, and slowly drew her sword, the Khan-Blade, from its scabbard.

citation.text: "Bond and Blood" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Dec 2014.

timeline.summary: In a flashback, thirteen-year-old Anafenza lives aboard her house's rolling fortress on the Salt Road.
timeline.quote: At thirteen, she had spent most of her life rumbling from city to city throughout the Abzan lands

citation.text: "Bond and Blood" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Dec 2014.

timeline.summary: Anafenza is introduced to her cousin Oret and to Gvar Barzeel, a krumar orc raised by her uncle after the battle that killed his Mardu parents and her cousin.
timeline.quote: Gvar was a krumar, which meant he was not born in the Abzan.

citation.text: "Bond and Blood" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Dec 2014.

timeline.summary: Anafenza lashes out at Gvar, insisting they are not family, and he replies that neither chose their family.
timeline.quote: We're not cousins, Gvar! We're not even family!

citation.text: "Bond and Blood" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Dec 2014.

timeline.summary: Hakrez, the kin-tree warden, teaches Anafenza that the kin-tree belongs to blood-kin and bond-kin alike.
timeline.quote: This tree belongs to all of them.

citation.text: "Bond and Blood" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Dec 2014.

timeline.summary: Undead mastodons rise from the sand and a Sultai war party ambushes the caravan fortress.
timeline.quote: A Sultai war party!" Anafenza saw dozens of archers take positions at the parapet.

citation.text: "Bond and Blood" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Dec 2014.

timeline.summary: Ancestral spirits fight an undead mastodon, but the others crash into the fortress and Anafenza is thrown from the kin-tree as it splits.
timeline.quote: Anafenza couldn't focus, everything went sideways, and the Salt Road rushed up to toward her.

citation.text: "Bond and Blood" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Dec 2014.

timeline.summary: Anafenza finds the kin-tree shattered and the warden Hakrez dead.
timeline.quote: Anafenza recognized the lifeless body of Hakrez, the kin-tree warden, whose breastplate was caved in.

citation.text: "Bond and Blood" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Dec 2014.

timeline.summary: As the Sultai retreat, Anafenza discovers Abzan soldiers slaughtering their own kin at the fallen fortress.
timeline.quote: She saw Abzan butchering Abzan.

citation.text: "Bond and Blood" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Dec 2014.

timeline.summary: Gvar tells Anafenza her parents are dead and is hit by an arrow as they flee into the wastes.
timeline.quote: Your parents are dead. As is my bond-father.

citation.text: "Bond and Blood" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Dec 2014.

timeline.summary: Anafenza and Gvar share grapes during their march, and Gvar says the clan will demand justice for the betrayal.
timeline.quote: Our house was betrayed, but our clan will demand justice.

citation.text: "Bond and Blood" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Dec 2014.

timeline.summary: Alone at a dead village tree, Anafenza weeps for her family.
timeline.quote: All she could see was her kin-tree, splintered and dead.

citation.text: "Bond and Blood" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Dec 2014.

timeline.summary: Anafenza ambushes two traitorous Abzan pursuers, killing one with her sword.
timeline.quote: One of the men turned in time to receive the point of Anafenza's blade below his breastplate.

citation.text: "Bond and Blood" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Dec 2014.

timeline.summary: Interrogated, the captured attacker names Oret as the member of her house who hired the Sultai.
timeline.quote: Oret. It was Oret.

citation.text: "Bond and Blood" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Dec 2014.

timeline.summary: Back in the present, Anafenza coolly confronts Oret, who says he thought she was dead.
timeline.quote: You were dead.

citation.text: "Bond and Blood" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Dec 2014.

timeline.summary: Anafenza scars Oret's face with the Khan-Blade, disowns him before the First Tree, declares him her enemy, and has Gvar, her brother, show him out.
timeline.quote: I disown you, Oret. You are no longer of my blood.

citation.text: "Bond and Blood" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Dec 2014.

timeline.summary: In the current timeline Oret follows Anafenza into the desert and personally kills her to save her spirit.
timeline.quote: To save her spirit, Oret personally killed her, allowing her soul to stay with the ancestor spirits nearby.

citation.text: "Oret", section "Current timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oret gathers amber and places it around a dead tree, preserving Anafenza as a warrior spirit.
timeline.quote: Oret ensured that Anafenza lived on as a fierce kin-tree warrior spirit.

citation.text: "Oret", section "Current timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Anafenza is executed for kin-tree worship, but a ghostly figure like her is seen fighting alongside the Dromoka.
timeline.quote: However, she practiced ancient kin-tree worship, and for that she was executed.

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 2
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 2". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Mar 2015.

timeline.summary: Anafenza is executed for worshipping her ancestors, though many secretly keep to the old ways.
timeline.quote: Even after Anafenza was executed, many secretly maintained their beliefs in the old ways.

citation.text: Echoes of the Kin Tree (Dragons of Tarkir, 2015), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Anafenza and other defectors challenge the dragonlord and are killed.
timeline.quote: Resistance to Dromoka grew from defectors like Anafenza who challenged the dragonlord and were ultimately killed for their disobedience.

citation.text: "Dromoka", section "Defeat". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Anafenza is executed by Oret; Sidisi is killed and resurrected as a sibsig vizier to Silumgar.
timeline.quote: Sidisi is killed and resurrected as a sibsig vizier to Silumgar.

citation.text: "Tarkir/Timeline", section "Dragons of Tarkir". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the flashback, Oret and Captain Anafenza flee a Kolaghan horde through a canyon after their fortress falls and their lines break.
timeline.quote: But here they were, their fortress lost and their lines broken, fleeing for their lives before the bulk of a Kolaghan horde.

citation.text: "The Guardian" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: A Kolaghan orc kills Oret's ibex with a lightning spear and attacks him; Anafenza kills the orc by drawing out his life with golden-white light.
timeline.quote: It passed through him, pulling something unseen but vital from him as it passed, leaving him lifeless in the dust.

citation.text: "The Guardian" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Anafenza leads Oret to a kin-tree in a dead-end chamber, revealing that amber vessels and the carved tree anchor ancestor spirits.
timeline.quote: Spirits can be carried in amber, but I believe the tree is their anchor.

citation.text: "The Guardian" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Gvar Barzeel and dozens of Kolaghan warriors enter the chamber, and Anafenza calls on the tree's ancestors.
timeline.quote: Spirits of this tree, ancestors of my people, your descendants need you.

citation.text: "The Guardian" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Anafenza merges with the ancestor spirits and kills Gvar and his entire warband.
timeline.quote: Gvar, the shamans, all of the Kolaghan raiders—they didn't stand a chance.

citation.text: "The Guardian" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: A dragon of Kolaghan's brood dives at Anafenza and is torn apart by a bolt of golden light made of spirits, while the rest flee.
timeline.quote: They moved as a massive bolt of golden light, and at its advance the dragon tried to reverse course.

citation.text: "The Guardian" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Oret's scalelord lands in the chamber, crushing the kin-tree and learning of Anafenza's necromancy.
timeline.quote: their scalelord descended into the chamber where, beneath its great weight, the ancient tree fell to splinters.

citation.text: "The Guardian" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Oret asks his scalelord to let him execute Anafenza himself, and the dragon agrees.
timeline.quote: Please, my scalelord, allow me to be the one to execute her.

citation.text: "The Guardian" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Oret beheads Anafenza as she kneels, whispering that it is not the end.
timeline.quote: This is not the end," he whispered to his captain.

citation.text: "The Guardian" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Oret is honored in Kavah, then secretly gathers the amber shards and plants a new tree with Anafenza's name carved in it, erasing it from maps so her spirit has an anchor.
timeline.quote: It was to be Anafenza's tree.

citation.text: "The Guardian" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Oret reveals he now travels the Dromoka lands to tell the truth of the Guardian.
timeline.quote: I now travel our territory to share the truth. She is, as Yeffa said, a guardian.

citation.text: "The Guardian" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Anafenza is martyred for worshipping her ancestors and now walks among them.
timeline.quote: Martyred for worshipping her ancestors, she now walks among them.

citation.text: Anafenza, Kin-Tree Spirit (Dominaria United Commander, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: In 4559 AR Gvar, as Kolaghan's whipmaster, attacks the Abzan; Anafenza uses spirit necromancy to kill all his warriors.
timeline.quote: she killed all of Gvar's warriors

citation.text: "Gvar Barzeel", section "Current timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Kin-Tree Felothar explains why the ancestors matter and how Anafenza showed Dromoka's claim to be a lie.
timeline.quote: Anafenza proved that to be a lie when she discovered and bonded with one.

citation.text: "Spirits of the Abzan" by Izzy Wasserstein. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2026.

timeline.summary: Felothar, separated from her sunken unit, communes with the spirit of Anafenza at a Kin-Tree.
timeline.quote: She came across a sunken Kin-Tree and communed with the spirit of Anafenza .

citation.text: "Felothar Zanhar", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kwaro reports to Anafenza that the house leaders are ready, then invites them one by one, leaving Oret for last.
timeline.quote: Kwaro was then sent to invite the house leaders one by one up to the Khan's dais

citation.text: "Kwaro", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Anafenza cuts Oret, performs a blood rite, disowns him and declares him her enemy.
timeline.quote: she declared him her enemy

citation.text: "Kwaro", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: He is her captain of the guard.
relations.quote: Kwaro was Anafenza's captain of the guard

citation.text: "Bond and Blood" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Dec 2014.

relations.quote: Now Gvar, my brother, show him out.

citation.text: "Bond and Blood" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Dec 2014.

relations.note: In this timeline Dromoka took the place Anafenza would have held as khan.

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 2
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 2". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Mar 2015.

relations.note: Anafenza is both his captain and his cousin.
relations.quote: His captain—his cousin—was going to die there.

citation.text: "The Guardian" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2015.

relations.quote: A moment later, it was done.

citation.text: "The Guardian" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2015.

citation.text: "Oret". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

citation.text: Tarkir: Dragonstorm Promos: card flavor text (Tarkir: Dragonstorm Promos, 2025), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.
